##### Project general facts

SquareX One is a residential development located in the vibrant community. Thoughtfully designed by Tasmeer Indigo Properties, the project brings together sleek contemporary architecture and lush outdoor zones to offer residents a lifestyle rooted in wellness, nature, and urban convenience. With a focus on vibrant city living, the tower features expansive terraces, panoramic views, and a façade that reflects modern elegance, creating homes that are both sophisticated and welcoming.

The project boasts an impressive suite of over forty lifestyle amenities designed to support wellness and community. From a rooftop infinity pool and lazy river to coworking lounges, kids' splash zones, outdoor gyms, and zen gardens, every corner of SquareX One is dedicated to enhancing daily life. Residents enjoy not only luxury and relaxation but also a complete ecosystem of entertainment, fitness, and connectivity within the heart of the city.

Every residence at SquareX One is crafted with smart layouts, premium materials, and floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the interiors with natural light. Integrated smart home systems ensure effortless control and enhanced comfort, while the spaces are optimized to cater to the modern urban dweller. Featuring modern finishing with high-quality materials and fully equipped kitchens, each home offers a seamless blend of function, sophistication, and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Jumeirah Village Circle, a vibrant residential community in the heart of new Dubai, this exceptional location is known for its family-friendly environment and balanced mix of modern urban living and tranquil suburban ambiance. The area offers a blend of villas, townhouses, and apartments, making it an attractive location for both families and young professionals, with a wide range of amenities including parks, schools, and healthcare facilities all within easy reach.

The location is distinguished by its unique charm, blending traditional Arabian and modern architectural styles. Well-connected to key areas of Dubai through major highways, the community is thoughtfully planned with lush green spaces, walking paths, and communal areas that encourage outdoor activities and social interaction. A variety of retail outlets, dining establishments, and leisure facilities ensure residents have everything they need close at hand.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modern living, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Village Circle delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of green spaces, thoughtful infrastructure, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — vibrant, balanced and effortlessly refined.
